Class GameLoop

java.lang.Object
javafx.animation.AnimationTimer
com.cuseto.pong.game.loop.GameLoop
public final class GameLoop extends javafx.animation.AnimationTimer
Drives the game's per-frame loop: on every JavaFX animation frame, it updates the GameSession state and then renders it.

Extends AnimationTimer, so AnimationTimer.start() (inherited) begins the loop and AnimationTimer.stop() (inherited) halts it; JavaFX invokes handle(long) once per frame while running.

      public GameLoop(GameSession initialState, GameUpdater updater, Consumer<GameSession> renderer)
      Creates a game loop that updates and renders the specified game session once per frame.
      Parameters:
      initialState - the game session this loop will update and render every frame; must not be null
      updater - the update logic applied to initialState every frame; must not be null
      renderer - the callback invoked with initialState every frame, after updating; must not be null
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if any argument is null
